title: Render duplicates: SDFCircle + SDFCircleSimple, one SDF draw signature, ColorBox on SDFRoundedRect (legacy staging path deleted), one GPU buffer abstraction, LwjglGL + HeadlessGL
description:
Repo plan merge 3D.20. (a) SDFCircle and SDFCircleSimple are two circle primitives with two shaders and different edge constants (8 vs 2): one SDFCircle with border options. (b) Every SDF primitive takes the same geometry-first draw(..., Color, Camera) form; SDFBezier is configured through public fields (20-45), SDFUnion only has drawCentered. (c) ColorBox is the only user of ShaderProgram's legacy staging path (drawColorRegion ~982, useBuffer): rebuild it on SDFRoundedRect with radius 0, delete the staging path. (d) shaders/VertexArrayObject + VertexBufferObject and model/VertexBuffer + VertexLayout are two buffer abstractions (HalfEdgeMeshRuntime uses both, 92-95); LWJGL BufferUtils leaks into graphics/render/model (VertexBuffer, AssimpModelRuntime, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime): one abstraction over IxBuffer. (e) LwjglGL (728) and HeadlessGL (891) make the same LWJGL calls and differ only in context creation; DefaultBuffer and HeadlessBuffer likewise: one implementation with a context choice. GL.setWindowTitle duplicates Platform.setTitle; ShaderProgram detects the web build by class name (512-523) though gl.usesWebGlsl() exists. Keep existing class names where one survives.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. Each of (a)-(e) done or justified on the ticket.
2. Screenshots of the SDF demo scenes, the menus, a mesh scene and a headless screenshot run match master.
3. Unit suite and headless capture pass; launch entry.
testing-plan:
1. Before/after screenshots of the anatomy scenes and menus, headless and windowed.
2. mvn test.
changes-made: (a) SDFCircleSimple merged into SDFCircle (one sdf_circle.fs, radius-normalised, optional border band via borderThickness/borderColor, edge sharpness 0.5/scale as SDFCircleSimple had). Old SDFCircle never overrode calculateQuad, so Drawing.drawCircle drew a degenerate quad at the origin; it now draws (visible in irregular-grid-canvas). SDFCircleTest covers it.

(b) SDFBezier gets draw(pA, control, pB, c, c2, camera); its six dead config fields are gone. SDFUnion and SDFTexture drop the unused long-id overloads and SDFUnion's unused drawCentered; both full-quad draws now go through ShaderDrawable's persistent path. SDFUnion no longer imports LWJGL.

(c) ColorBox is an SDFRoundedRect with radius 0, no border and a new edgeSharpness field set hard; ColorShader, color.vs/fs, drawColorRegion and the uncalled drawSDFRegion/drawSDFLinearGradient are deleted. Justified: the staging buffer itself stays, because Font's glyph batching (SDFTexture.drawRegionNoSetup -> drawTextureRegion) still uses it; ColorBox was not its only user. The 200-line drawTexture named in the plan no longer exists. Scene's tooltip no longer builds a ColorBox per frame.

ShaderDrawable fix: it only re-uploaded vertices when the quad moved, so a colour change (or z change) with the same quad never reached the GPU; it now compares the uploaded colour and depth. Regression test in SDFCircleTest.

(e) HeadlessGL merged into LwjglGL: LwjglGL() uses the caller's context, LwjglGL(width, height) creates the hidden-window 3.3 core context; real deleteShader/deleteProgram, alpha in readPixels, getMouseButton false offscreen. HeadlessBuffer deleted, DefaultBuffer used everywhere (tests too). GL.setWindowTitle deleted (callers use Platform.setTitle; LwjglPlatform skips it with no window), IxdarWindow.setTitle and WebLauncher.setTitle deleted. ShaderProgram uses gl.usesWebGlsl() instead of the class-name check. Unused HeadlessPlatform.screenshot removed.

(d) Partially done, rest justified: VertexBuffer no longer uses LWJGL BufferUtils. Merging VertexBuffer/VertexLayout with VertexArrayObject/VertexBufferObject and removing BufferUtils from AssimpModelRuntime/HalfEdgeMeshRuntime needs edits in the mesh render runtimes, which other tickets own and this agent was told not to touch.

Verification: before/after headless screenshots of the anatomy scenes, main menu, trade, irregular grid, mesh-viewer, its terminal chrome and graph tool (tmp/view-24-before*, tmp/view-24-after*); details in tmp/view-24-measurements.json. mvn test: 554 run, 0 failed. Launch entry 'VIEW-24: irregular-grid-canvas'.
review-summary: SDFCircle absorbs SDFCircleSimple, ColorBox draws through SDFRoundedRect instead of its own shader, and LwjglGL with an offscreen-window constructor replaces HeadlessGL. The duplicates had drifted apart: Drawing's SDFCircle never drew at all, and colour-only changes never reached the GPU.
